4423-4872-6886-8344.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
4423-4872-6886-8344.notablePrerequisites: Nog's second activated ability has been activated.
4423-4872-6886-8344.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

2317-2511-5478-7084.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

1479-2841-3585-8105.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Escape Tunnel.
1479-2841-3585-8105.description:
Fetch a land using Escape Tunnel.
When the fetched land enters, Greensleeves and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Greensleeves trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Greensleeves from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Greensleeves triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3899-6249-7920--5.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Tresserhorn's Lord trigger.
Resolve the Tresserhorn's Lord trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4247-4435-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4247-4435-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3234-3293-4247-5413.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4247-5413.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-4247-5413.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

654-2136-2178-7898.easyPrerequisites: Opponents control two or more artifacts.
654-2136-2178-7898.description:
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R}, creating a token copy of Smaug.
Put the Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Smaug token's first ability triggers, creating a number of tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor trigger that many times, untapping the Treasures.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}.
Repeat.
654-2136-2178-7898.notes: If opponents control exactly two artifacts, you can still get infinite Treasures by using Orthion's second ability instead. If opponents control three or more, either ability will net infinite Treasures.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

955-3259-5982.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
955-3259-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

850-4644-7791.description:
Activate Overgrown Battlement by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Overgrown Battlement.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Overgrown Battlement.
Repeat.

670-1619-6153-6473.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6153-6473.description:
Cast Mardu Siegebreaker by paying its mana cost.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Vicious Battlerager until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, causing Vicious Battlerager to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Mardu Siegebreaker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Mardu Siegebreaker trigger, exiling Vicious Battlerager until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Mardu Siegebreaker.
Repeat from step 5.

1362-1479-1817.description:
Cast Kodama of the East Tree either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{G}{G} plus commander tax, if applicable.
Holding priority, cast Double Major by paying {G}{U}, copying the Kodama of the East Tree spell, with the copy not being legendary.
Resolve both Kodama of the East Tree spells.
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
Both Kodama of the East Trees trigger.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the nontoken Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
The token Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
In response, activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the token Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
The nontoken Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Repeat from step 6.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

1362-3609-6099-6881.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When it enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Moxite Refinery by paying {2}, tapping it and removing three +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra, putting three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Oboro's first ability by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Oboro's last ability by paying {1}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
1362-3609-6099-6881.notes: You can remove as many +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra to then place counters on Magistrate's Scepter. If you remove more than three, you may be able to forego steps 1-3 during some turns. You must ensure, however, that Mossborn Hydra will continue to have three or more +1/+1 counters on it afterwards.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-7371-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Rite of the Dragoncaller
1618-2440-7371-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Rite of the Dragoncaller triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-7371-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Rite of the Dragoncaller. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

240-2034-5470-7175.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding {C}{C}
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7228.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two instant and/or sorcery cards in all graveyards.
5256-6972-7228.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Academy Elite.
When Academy Elite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

489-586-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

907-1479-7201.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-7201.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Sapling Nursery, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sapling Nursery trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Sapling Nursery trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6705-7060.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

997-2842-5170-6132.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Blood Artist triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve the Blood Artist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

3490-4785-6723-7075.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that has not been tapped this turn.
3490-4785-6723-7075.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Grim Poppet and with toughness 2 or greater

2760-3108-3680.description:
Activate Grim Poppet by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Stunt Double.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Stunt Double by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, putting a -1/-1 counter on Grim Poppet.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

132-1283-5200.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Chromatic Orrery's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.
132-1283-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

997-5572-6249--5.easyPrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
997-5572-6249--5.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Dragon Appeasement trigger.
Resolve the Dragon Appeasement trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with five or more charge counters on it

198-4067-4182.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least six {U}.
Cast Whispers of the Muse with buyback by paying {5}{U}, causing you to draw a card and return Whispers of the Muse to your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

1987-4423-5849.manaNeeded: {2} if Ghostly Flicker is in your hand
1987-4423-5849.easyPrerequisites:
You control three additional Islands.
You've cast a spell this turn if Ghostly Flicker is on top of your library.
1987-4423-5849.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker either from your hand by paying {2}{U} or from the top of your library by paying {U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and another artifact, creature or land.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

215-3480-4010-6723.description:
Cast Farmer Cotton by paying at least {3}{G}{W}
When Farmer Cotton enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three 1/1 Halfling creature tokens and three Food tokens.
Activate Farmer Cotton, three Halflings and three Foods by tapping them, adding {4}{G}{G}{W}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Farmer Cotton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
215-3480-4010-6723.notes: It is recommended to pay at least {1} additional to start to get infinite untapped tokens. This mana will be recuperated throughout the combo.

1909-4452.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {G}.
1909-4452.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.

1329-1778-2178-5147.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-5147.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

186-1741-4013.notablePrerequisites: You control up to two lands that can tap to produce at least {1}{C}.
186-1741-4013.description:
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {1}{C}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.

1636-3490-6258.notablePrerequisites:
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}.
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it.
1636-3490-6258.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield, which enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Intruder Alarm and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate a mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
Repeat from step 2.

225-1479-5700-5701-5702.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sickness.
You are able to play a land this turn.
225-1479-5700-5701-5702.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

428-1692-1694-2736.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
Helm of the Host attached to Ghyrson Starn.
428-1692-1694-2736.description:
Activate Zedruu by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

141-1223-5256.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one creature on the battlefield.
141-1223-5256.description:
Cast Fake Your Own Death by paying {1}{B}, targeting any creature.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Fake Your Own Death, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Fake Your Own Death.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield and creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Altar of Dementia abilities, causing any number of players to mill that many cards.

851-1651-2797-4659.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two 1/1 Servo artifact creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Servos, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Retrofitter Foundry's first ability to untap it and get infinite untapped Servo tokens.

1981-3499-4050-4629.notablePrerequisites: You have the highest life total.
1981-3499-4050-4629.description:
Activate Pyrohemia by paying {R}, dealing 1 damage to each player and each creature your opponent control.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Soldier token, adding {R}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Fable of the Mirror-Breaker // Reflection of Kiki-Jiki

2105-3337-4737.notablePrerequisites:
Reflection of Kiki-Jiki and Captain Lannery Storm do not have summoning sickness.
Captain Lannery Storm cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
2105-3337-4737.description:
Activate Reflection of KIki-Jiki by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Combat Celebrant with haste.
Declare Captain Lannery Storm and Combat Celebrant token as an attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebbrant as it attacks.
The token triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Captain Lannery Storm deals combat damage to a player, causing you to create a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

614-1283-1518-1987.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
614-1283-1518-1987.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first activated ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {C}, targeting Chromatic Orrery and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Chromatic Orrery's last ability any number of times.
